bibl.title: Der Klassische Archäologe Hermann Thiersch (1874-1939) und der Erwerb der Basler Papyrussammlung im Jahr 1899/1900.
bibl.seg: Sabine R. Huebner, Der Klassische Archäologe Hermann Thiersch (1874-1939) und der Erwerb der Basler Papyrussammlung im Jahr 1899/1900.
bibl.note: During the winter of 1899/1900, the young archaeologist Hermann Thiersch traveled to Cairo to purchase papyri for the universities in Basel, Strasbourg, and Munich. His correspondence with several archaeologists and classicists offer an insight into their collaboration working in Egypt at the turn of the twentieth century.
